## Required

One field: the shared trip ID, if a row is reported. All 40 vessel-attribute fields are optional.

These cover dimensions, engines, storage, preservation, electronics and waste management.

## Available

Optional vessel attributes were not profiled for the 67 selected trips in 2025.

The agreed export scope leaves all 40 optional fields empty; ObServe attributes may be outdated.

Consolidate vessel attributes in the ROS database from RAV separately from this workbook export.

## To decide

Ask Emmanuel whether the sheet should contain no data rows or one row with only the trip ID.

The database requires no separate attributes row or placeholder associations. IOTC and importer rules remain open.

The shared vessel record can be supplied by other sheets.

For later RAV consolidation, review access, field coverage, units, freshness and vessel matching separately.

Further ObServe attribute investigation remains outside the agreed scope.
